marker.description: Red paint mark on the posterior surface of the acetabulum

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the red paint mark.
main_explanation: The red mark is located in the central depression of the acetabulum, which is the fovea capitis femoris. This is the attachment site for the ligament of the head of the femur (ligamentum teres).

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures attaches to the fovea capitis femoris?
options: Ligament of the head of the femur
supporting_question.explanation: The ligament of the head of the femur (ligamentum teres) connects the fovea capitis femoris to the acetabular notch.
